blocks.tamil_translation: these Allah Ta'ala loves. He hates 1. your engaging in futile arguments, 2. wasting wealth, and 3. asking too many questions,” Hazrat Abu Hurairah (RA) narrates that Rasulullah ﷺ said.

blocks.arabic_text: عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ ﵁ قَالَ: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللهِ ﷺ: مَنْ أَطَاعَنِي فَقَدْ أَطَاعَ اللهَ، وَمَنْ عَصَانِي فَقَدْ عَصَي اللهَ، وَمَنْ أَطَاعَ اْلإِمَامَ فَقَدْ أَطَاعَنِي، وَمَنْ عَصَي اْلإِمَامَ فَقَدْ عَصَانِي.
blocks.source_reference_arabic: رواه ابن ماجه، باب طاعة الامام، رقم: ٢٨٥٩
blocks.tamil_translation: “Whoever obeyed me obeyed Allah Ta'ala, whoever disobeyed me has disobeyed Allah Ta'ala, whoever obeyed the leader of the Muslims obeyed me, and whoever disobeyed the amir of the Muslims has disobeyed me,” Hazrat Abu Hurairah (RA) narrates that the Prophet ﷺ said.

blocks.arabic_text: عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ ﵄ قَالَ: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللهِ ﷺ: مَنْ رَأَي مِنْ أَمِيرِهِ شَيْئاً يَكْرَهُهُ فَلْيَصْبِرْ، فَإِنَّهُ مَنْ فَارَقَ الْجَمَاعَةَ شِبْرًا فَمَاتَ، فَمِيتَةٌ جَاهِلِيَّةٌ.
blocks.source_reference_arabic: رواه مسلم، باب وجوب ملازمة جماعة المسلمين....،رقم:٤٧٩٠
blocks.tamil_translation: “Whoever sees his amir doing something he dislikes, let him adopt patience. For whoever separates from the Jama'ah (the group) of the Muslims even by a hand-span, and dies in that same state (without then making tawbah), has died the death of the time of ignorance,” Hazrat Ibn Abbas (RA) narrates that Rasulullah ﷺ said.

blocks.text: Explanation:- The meaning of “has died the death of the time of ignorance” is: “In the time of ignorance
